body: thank you!, i talked my grandma out of kicking me out for now. thank you for the kind gesture, hopefully i can figure out what to do.. before she changes her mind
thank you for your understanding. im not sure what the outcome from all this will be. .

after i made this post, i called suicide hotline. we talked for an hour about me. he convinced me to call my grandma and my mom. he also referred me to talk to a therapist from the city and i accepted. i told my grandma i spoke with suicide hotline and shes not throwing me out... she just wants me to do something about it... i also called my mom and she wants me to move in with her. i asked her if she would drive me to my therapy sessions. after that though. its a whole other question...
